request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change his clothes and skin: take off the brown tunic so his chest, belly, arms and legs are bare skin; he wears only a short orange-brown leather loincloth and one orange-brown leather strap across the chest; the striped headband becomes a plain orange-brown leather headband; orange-brown leather wrist wraps. His skin a deeper, darker true goblin green. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
